purpose: Local quality contract for the main user workflow before introducing a larger external evaluation platform.
evaluation_strategy: deterministic-first with optional live OpenRouter smoke

fixture.description: Create selected and excluded sources with unique markers.

acceptance_checks: semantic_search_selected_source_only passes
chat_context_includes_selected_not_excluded passes
chat_evidence_payload_ready contains selected marker and excludes excluded marker
cases.risk_if_missing: The system may cite or reason over sources the user did not select.

fixture.description: Use a selected source about workflow reliability, then ask a question unrelated to that source.

acceptance_checks: answer states available evidence is insufficient
answer does not invent facts outside selected source
citations are absent because the selected source does not support the question
quality_filters.evidence_sufficiency is insufficient
cases.risk_if_missing: The model may answer confidently when the user's evidence set does not support the question.

fixture.description: Use a selected copper background source, then ask for next-week price direction and trading advice.

acceptance_checks: answer states selected evidence is insufficient for the actionable request
quality_filters.insufficient_evidence_reason is selected_sources_actionable_question_requires_directional_evidence
LLM is not called when the selected evidence lacks directional or trading basis
citations are absent because topical overlap alone is not treated as support
cases.risk_if_missing: The system may turn loosely related background material into unsupported price direction or trading advice.

fixture.description: Use a selected directional copper source without a date or forecast horizon, then ask for next-week direction and trading advice.

acceptance_checks: answer states selected evidence is insufficient for the requested time window
quality_filters.insufficient_evidence_reason is selected_sources_temporal_question_requires_time_window_evidence
LLM is not called when the selected evidence lacks date, recency, or horizon support
published_at metadata is accepted as a source time anchor, while upload created_at is not exposed as freshness evidence
cases.risk_if_missing: The system may reuse undated directional views as if they supported current, recent, or next-week decisions.

fixture.description: Use a selected copper source with an old publication date and ask for current next-week direction and trading advice.

acceptance_checks: answer states selected evidence is stale for the current question
quality_filters.insufficient_evidence_reason is selected_sources_temporal_evidence_is_stale_for_current_question
LLM is not called when the latest selected-source time anchor is too old
UI trust receipt can distinguish stale evidence from missing time-window evidence
cases.risk_if_missing: The system may present old directional evidence as if it supported current or near-term decisions.

fixture.description: Use a selected source that explicitly supports next-quarter copper direction, then ask for next-week direction and trading advice.

acceptance_checks: answer states selected evidence is insufficient because the requested horizon conflicts with the evidence horizon
quality_filters.insufficient_evidence_reason is selected_sources_temporal_horizon_mismatch
LLM is not called when selected evidence supports a different explicit forecast period
UI trust receipt can distinguish horizon mismatch from missing or stale temporal evidence
cases.risk_if_missing: The system may use long-horizon or quarter-horizon evidence to answer short-horizon trading questions.

fixture.description: Use a selected source with a structured medium-horizon copper claim, then ask for next-week direction and trading advice.

acceptance_checks: answer states selected structured claim evidence is insufficient because the claim horizon conflicts with the requested horizon
quality_filters.insufficient_evidence_reason is selected_sources_claim_temporal_horizon_mismatch
LLM is not called even though a structured claim citation exists
claims_used and citations are zero in the user-visible response
cases.risk_if_missing: Structured claim citations may bypass raw-source sufficiency gates and support the wrong decision horizon.

fixture.description: Use a selected source with a structured claim whose valid_from is in the future, then ask for current next-week trading guidance.

acceptance_checks: semantic_search exclude_expired filters out claims whose valid_from is after the reference time
selected-source sufficiency returns selected_sources_claim_validity_window_mismatch for not-yet-active structured citations
trust receipt labels and explains the validity-window mismatch
the rule is deterministic and does not require an LLM call
cases.risk_if_missing: The system may use structured views before they are effective or after they expire, weakening time-sensitive decision reliability.

fixture.description: Use a selected copper background source, then ask briefing mode to generate next-week price direction and trading guidance.

acceptance_checks: briefing quality_filters.evidence_sufficiency is insufficient
briefing recommended_action is watch instead of directional or actionable
LLM call count is zero when selected evidence lacks directional or trading basis
claims_used and source_claim_ids are zero in the user-visible response
cases.risk_if_missing: Briefing mode may bypass chat sufficiency gates and turn loosely related background material into unsupported trading summaries.

fixture.description: Use scope acceptance to create a briefing response in the chat session.

acceptance_checks: briefing_api_returns_selected_scope passes
briefing_evidence_payload_ready passes
UI contains briefing conclusion, evidence, trust receipt, and trace surfaces
cases.risk_if_missing: Briefing mode could degrade into an unstructured answer without evidence or reference time.

fixture.description: Persist a briefing and matching JobRun result summary, then fetch the briefing detail endpoint.

acceptance_checks: GET /api/v1/briefings/{id} returns decision_guardrail and llm_trace from JobRun
GET /api/v1/briefings/{id} returns quality_filters from JobRun
GET /api/v1/briefings/{id} returns claims_used, source_claim_ids, and source scope
briefing detail keeps enough context for later audit and trust receipt rendering
cases.risk_if_missing: A user can see quality and scope data immediately after generation, but lose that trust context when reopening the briefing detail later.

fixture.description: Use committee acceptance with selected source and trace persistence.

acceptance_checks: committee_api_returns_selected_scope passes
committee_evidence_payload_ready passes
committee_decision_trace_persisted includes retrieval, scope, quality, guardrail, and llm_call
cases.risk_if_missing: Committee output would be hard to audit and could lose role-specific evidence grounding.

fixture.description: Use a selected copper background source, then ask committee mode for next-week price direction and operating guidance.

acceptance_checks: committee quality_filters.evidence_sufficiency is insufficient
committee recommended_action is watch and direction is neutral
no debate rounds are generated when selected evidence lacks directional or trading basis
LLM call count is zero and data_sources.claims.count is zero
cases.risk_if_missing: Committee mode may bypass chat and briefing sufficiency gates, creating a false sense of rigor around unsupported evidence.

fixture.description: Persist a committee debate and matching JobRun result summary, then fetch the committee detail endpoint.

acceptance_checks: GET /api/v1/committee/{id} returns decision_guardrail and llm_trace from JobRun
GET /api/v1/committee/{id} returns quality_filters from JobRun
GET /api/v1/committee/{id} returns claims_used and selected source scope
committee detail keeps enough context for later audit and trust receipt rendering
cases.risk_if_missing: A user can see committee evidence sufficiency immediately after generation, but lose that trust context when reopening the debate detail later.

fixture.description: Mock a committee detail response with quality filters, selected-source scope, guardrail, and llm_trace, then open the /debate detail page.

acceptance_checks: debate detail renders a collapsed trust receipt for selected-source insufficient evidence
debate detail shows source scope count and claims_used count
expanded trust receipt shows model call count and effective guardrail action
decision chat trust receipt behavior still passes after extracting the shared component
cases.risk_if_missing: The backend can preserve committee trust context while users reopening the detail page still cannot see why the decision was cautious or whether the selected-source scope was applied.

fixture.description: Upload a marked text file and process it through synchronous and asynchronous ingestion paths.

acceptance_checks: upload_txt_creates_source passes
ingestion_process_completes passes
async_ingestion_progress_observable passes
async_progress_survives_memory_tracker_loss passes
cases.risk_if_missing: Users cannot trust that uploaded files were actually parsed, indexed, and made available for answers.

fixture.description: Use deterministic chat and utility tests to verify user-facing answer normalization.

acceptance_checks: raw JSON answer payloads are normalized into readable text
prompt leakage and language mismatch produce visible integrity warnings
reference_time is visible in answer content, not only stored in payload metadata
scope acceptance UI contains trust receipt and citation surfaces
cases.risk_if_missing: Users may see raw fields, prompt fragments, missing reference-time anchors, or malformed answers in the primary chat surface.

fixture.description: Build a chat quality report where one sentence cites evidence but a later material action sentence has no citation.

cases.command: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest apps/backend/tests/test_chat_quality_report.py -q; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cd apps\frontend; node tests\trustReceipt.test.mjs
acceptance_checks: quality_report emits uncited_material_claim when a material judgement sentence lacks a valid citation
quality_report.decision_ready is false for the uncited material claim case
evidence.uncited_material_claim_count and uncited_material_claims are populated
frontend trust receipt parses and surfaces the uncited material claim signal
cases.risk_if_missing: An answer may cite one safe sentence while adding an unsupported recommendation or directional claim later in the response.

fixture.description: Validate the controlled decision-quality cases, thresholds, source annotations, and product-owner promotion boundary.

acceptance_checks: all seven required decision-risk categories are present and structurally valid
fact units map only to citations inside the exact selected-source scope
abstention cases require cautious guardrail outcomes and forbid actionable language
model promotion remains blocked until the product owner reviews a representative real-source corpus
cases.risk_if_missing: A model or prompt change could pass transport and UI tests while regressing factual support, citation attribution, temporal or geographic scope, abstention, or operation safety.

fixture.description: Run the frontend production build script from apps/frontend.

acceptance_checks: TypeScript compilation completes without errors
Vite production build completes and writes dist assets
cases.risk_if_missing: The UI acceptance flow could pass in the dev server while the frontend still fails to compile or build for production.

fixture.description: Seed selected and excluded sources, require a real OpenRouter fusion call, and verify selected-source scoped chat grounding.

acceptance_checks: fusion model OpenRouter ping succeeds before chat
chat response uses selected_sources scope and returns citation entries only for the selected source
live chat returns a non-empty real-model answer with grounding terms
reference_time is visible in the answer content, not only stored in metadata
cases.risk_if_missing: The standard eval manifest may omit the Python real-model scoped-chat acceptance path, allowing real answer grounding, citation, or reference-time regressions to go unnoticed.

fixture.description: Start a temporary backend with SOPS-injected OpenRouter key and run one selected-source live chat.

acceptance_checks: OpenRouter connection test succeeds
live chat returns at least one citation
llm_trace records model call count, duration, tokens, and cost
cases.risk_if_missing: The deterministic suite could pass while real model routing, cost, latency, or trace observability is broken.

acceptance_checks: replay fixture preserves the original committee trace event count
replay fixture recomputes the same trigger reasons from event snapshots
replay fixture preserves source ids without reading the live database
cases.risk_if_missing: Historical committee trace failures could remain review-only and regress without deterministic replay coverage.
cases.reviewer_note: Self-contained trace replay fixture exported and validated before promotion to the canonical eval manifest.
